scope: Tracked Markdown in main and its pinned board submodule; historical evidence, generated and third-party documents included for review, with original evidence preserved.

deferred_checks: Remote CI status for the documentation push, per user request
known_document_limitations: Record 125 contains a 61-character Runtime payload SHA-256 transcription. The original remains, with an erratum stating it cannot be used as a verification checksum; the correct original was not recovered.
